name: NoteHush
subtitle: Plain text, tabs and drafts
promotionalText: A native Mac notepad for everyday text. Keep drafts and files in tabs, quit without a save prompt, and return to your workspace. No account, ads or cloud service.
description:
Make room for your next thought. NoteHush is a native plain-text editor for Mac, with tabs for open files and drafts you have not named yet.

Close the window or quit without an unsaved-file confirmation. NoteHush keeps private recovery copies so you can return to your tabs, unsaved text and place in the workspace. Explicit Save and Save As remain separate: you choose when to write to your files.

EVERYDAY EDITING
• Create, reorder and switch tabs with the mouse or keyboard.
• Reopen up to 20 recently closed tabs.
• Find and replace text, use case options, and go to a line.
• Undo and redo independently in each open tab during the session.
• Choose fonts, word wrap, zoom, and light, dark or system appearance.
• Print a document or selected text using macOS printing.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertisements, analytics SDK or built-in cloud sync. Drafts and recovery stay in the app’s private storage. Files you explicitly save may be handled by your chosen storage or backup provider.

PLAIN TEXT, PRESERVED
Open UTF-8 and BOM-marked UTF-16 files, with supported source encodings and line endings preserved. Unsupported or invalid bytes are rejected without changing the original file. Files larger than 100 MiB cannot be opened. NoteHush does not display rich-text, PDF or Office documents.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Private recovery is not a substitute for backups of important files.
